specs.Specific Uses For Product: Home entertainment, Smartphone or Tablet use

features: 160 W boAt Signature Sound: Escape reality with the 160 W boAt Signature Sound output of the Aavante Bar Orion Plus Soundbar. Feel sound the way it was intended while tuning into your favorite movies and web episodes.
2.1 Channel Soundbar with Wired Subwoofer: Featuring a subwoofer along with 2.1 channels, this soundbar is your front-row ticket to dynamic audio that mimics the theatre-like experience.

Multiple Connectivity Options: Stay connected to the enthralling audio of this soundbar using either wired or wireless connections. Added to the Bluetooth v5.3 compatibility, the Optical, HDMI (ARC), AUX, and USB ports let you kickstart entertainment at your convenience.
EQ Modes: Music, 3D, Movies, and News - this soundbar offers an EQ mode for every mood. By fine-tuning the sound to the type of content, Aavante Bar Orion Plus heightens immersive viewing.
Bass and Treble Controls: Feel impactful bass and treble keep you hooked for hours on end. Just use the equalizer controls and alter the bass and treble for adrenaline-raising feels!
